title: High-sensitivity whole-mount in situ Hybridization of Mouse Oocytes and Embryos
author: Sanada, Kotani
materials: For in situ hybridization, stock solutions were prepared as follows. 20x saline-sodium citrate (20x SSC: 3 M NaCl, 200 mM sodium citrate; pH 7.0) was autoclaved and stored. Torula RNA (Sigma) was dissolved in DDW at 50˚C and purified by phenol-, phenol-chloroform-, and chloroform-extraction. After ethanol precipitation, the RNAs were dissolved in DDW (10 mg/ml) and stored at -20˚C. 20x Denhardt’ solution was prepared by dissolving Ficol-400 (0.4%), polyvinylpyrrolidone (0.4%) and bovine serum albumin (0.4%) in DDW and was stored at -20˚C.

DIG- and fluorescein-labeled RNA probes were prepared by in vitro transcription with RNA polymerases and plasmid vectors containing target transcript sequences. One µg of linearized plasmid DNA was used as a template, and RNA probes were synthesized with SP6 or T7 RNA polymerase (Roche) and DIG or Fluorescein RNA Labeling Mix (Roche) for 2–3 h at 37˚C. After precipitation with isopropanol and sodium acetate, the RNA probes were dissolved in DDW. After determining the concentrations, the RNA probes were diluted (50 ng/µl) with probe dilution buffer (50% formamide, 5x SSC, 0.1% Tween-20) containing torula RNA (5 mg/ml) and were stored at -20˚C.

steps.title: Isolate oocytes and embryos (IVF)
steps.instruction: Maintain ICR mice on a 14‑h light/10‑h dark cycle at 25 °C with food and water ad libitum; isolate fully grown GV‑stage oocytes (>50 µm) by puncturing ovaries of 8‑week‑old females in M2 medium (94.7 mM NaCl, 4.8 mM KCl, 1.7 mM CaCl₂, 1.2 mM KH₂PO₄, 1.2 mM MgSO₄, 4.2 mM NaHCO₃, 20.9 mM HEPES, 23.3 mM sodium lactate, 0.3 mM sodium pyruvate, 5.6 mM glucose, 0.1 mM gentamicin, 0.01 mg ml⁻¹ phenol red, 4 mg ml⁻¹ BSA; pH 7.2‑7.4) containing 10 µM milrinone; do not inject these females with PMSG. For IVF, inject females with 5 IU PMSG, then 48 h later inject 5 IU hCG; collect ovulated mature oocytes from oviducts in HTF medium (102 mM NaCl, 4.7 mM KCl, 2 mM CaCl₂, 0.37 mM KH₂PO₄, 0.2 mM MgSO₄, 25 mM NaHCO₃, 21.4 mM sodium lactate, 0.33 mM sodium pyruvate, 2.8 mM glucose, 0.1 mM gentamicin, 0.01 mg ml⁻¹ phenol red, 4 mg ml⁻¹ BSA). Isolate sperm from the cauda epididymis of 8‑week‑old males with a needle in a petri dish filled with paraffin oil, transfer to HTF medium under oil, and incubate 2 h at 37 °C in 5 % CO₂/95 % air. Add sperm to the oocytes in HTF and incubate 6 h to allow fertilization. Wash resulting zygotes in M16 + EDTA medium (same composition as M2 plus 1 mM EDTA) and culture at 37 °C in 5 % CO₂/95 % air for 18 h.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Autoclave and store 20× SSC (3 M NaCl, 200 mM sodium citrate, pH 7.0). Dissolve Torula RNA (Sigma) in double‑distilled water (DDW) at 50 °C, purify by phenol, phenol‑chloroform, and chloroform extractions, precipitate with ethanol, redissolve at 10 mg ml⁻¹ in DDW and store at –20 °C. Prepare 20× Denhardt’s solution by mixing Ficol‑400 (0.4 %), polyvinylpyrrolidone (0.4 %), and bovine serum albumin (0.4 %) in DDW; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Synthesize DIG and fluorescein RNA probes
steps.instruction: Linearize the plasmid containing the target transcript; use 1 µg of the linearized DNA as template for in‑vitro transcription with SP6 or T7 RNA polymerase (Roche) and DIG or Fluorescein RNA Labeling Mix (Roche) for 2–3 h at 37 °C. Precipitate the transcribed RNA with isopropanol and sodium acetate, dissolve the pellet in DDW, measure concentration, and dilute to 50 ng µl⁻¹ in probe‑dilution buffer (50 % formamide, 5× SSC, 0.1 % Tween‑20) containing Torula RNA at 5 mg ml⁻¹. Store the probes at –20 °C.

steps.title: Treat samples with hexanediol or hexanetriol
steps.instruction: Incubate mouse oocytes or embryos in 50 mg ml⁻¹ 1,6‑hexanediol for 20 min at 37 °C; as a control, incubate parallel samples in 50 mg ml⁻¹ hexanetriol for the same time and temperature.

steps.title: Mount samples with DAPI and image
steps.instruction: Place the processed oocytes or embryos on a slide and cover with VECTASHIELD Mounting Medium containing DAPI (Funakoshi). Observe the mounted samples using a Zeiss LSM980 confocal microscope (Plan Apochromat 63×/1.4 NA oil DIC lens) or a Nikon N‑SIM super‑resolution microscope (CFI Apochromat TIRF 100×C oil lens).
